content_html_sanitized:
Posted November 1, 2000
(MarijuanaNews note: Several readers have sent me their emails to Lycos, below is my favorite.

Lycos’ " response " to all of them has been the same insulting form letter that has simply made matters worse.

As usual, I have used only the reader’s initials, but he gave his name and address when writing Lycos, for all the good it did. He still got a canned response – or non-response, to be a bit more accurate. Many thanks to all who wrote Lycos.)


See
Lycos Joins Drug Czar In Prohibitionist Propaganda Campaign to Lie to Children About Marijuana.
November 1, 2000

Dear Mr. Cowan,

I read Marijuananews every day and try to act on your information when possible. After the Lycos posting I wrote to them.

This is in regard to your free advertisement of ONDCP propaganda. As a father of two young children I believe the lies of this government organization is wrong for them and all our children. The ONDCP does not use science-based information and is there just to keep harmful prohibition going. It is not about stopping drug abuse but in keeping a race war/drug war going.

Lycos will not be used any more by me and I'll try my best to stop anyone else from using it. Thank You for your time.

P. C.
New York

So this is what they wrote back. Just thought you might be interested in their feedback. (they really piss me off)

Thank you for your time.
P. C.

Hello,

Thank you for writing to Lycos. We are always interested to hear the opinions of our users.

As you may know, our children's site called Lycos Zone was recently named as " Partner of the Month " by the White House Office of National Drug Control Policy (ONDCP) because Lycos Zone developed content encouraging kids to share their personal reasons for avoiding drugs.

While we understand your feelings about drug laws, Lycos feels that urging kids to abstain from the use of illegal drugs is a worthwhile endeavor. We are pleased that the ONDCP has recognized our efforts to help kids.

Lycos cannot comment on the actions of the ONDCP which do not involve our company.

We do not have an ongoing alliance with them and we clearly have no control over the policies made by elected and appointed officials.

Your comments about drug laws and the actions of the ONDCP should be shared with individuals who can effect change.

You may want to start with the President and his staff in the White House, along with the members of Congress who represent your state. You can find contact information for government officials here: http://www.whowhere.lycos.com/GovtPages

We appreciate your interest in Lycos. Please let us know if we can be of further assistance.

Lycos Customer Service
Lycos, Inc.

Be sure and log on to www.pot-tv.net for the 420 MarijuanaNews with Richard Cowan weekdays at any time after 4:20PM Pacific. The current programs are now available " on demand. " And if you miss any broadcasts, they are still available in the Archives.
